hazard_description: construction site cleanliness material storage scrap debris unobstructed access slippery passage wet floor drainage waste
indian_regulation: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (Central) Rules, 2026
applicability_conditions: Applies only where the Central Government is the appropriate government under the Code; confirm establishment coverage and inspection date.
required_safety_condition: Keep construction sites hygienic, provide material and equipment storage, remove debris, preserve access and egress, address slippery passages and wet floors, and supervise daily waste arrangements.
original_text: Every construction site and its premises and surroundings are to be kept clean and hygienic; storage is provided for materials and equipment; scrap, waste and debris are removed at appropriate intervals; loose material does not obstruct access, egress or passageways; slippery workplaces and passageways are cleaned or treated; wet floors have effective drainage and are kept dry and non-slippery, with suitable protective gear provided free; and daily waste collection, storage, disposal or treatment is arranged under effective supervision.
violation_criteria: A visible condition may support screening. Confirm the relevant clause, worksite coverage, persistence and evidence before a legal finding.
corrective_action: Clear blocked routes, remove loose waste, control slip hazards, and provide suitable drainage and storage.
issuing_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

hazard_description: heat stress sun exposure high outdoor temperature work rest cycle shade recovery hydration electrolytes
indian_regulation: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (Central) Rules, 2026
applicability_conditions: Applies only where the Central Government is the appropriate government under the Code; confirm establishment coverage, work and exposure conditions, and inspection date.
required_safety_condition: For health-impairing heat, cold or wet conditions, take the listed preventive measures. When heat from work or sun exposure remains and other controls are impracticable, provide a work-rest cycle with a shaded, cooler recovery space where practicable.
original_text: Whenever heat stress, cold or wet conditions can impair health or cause extreme discomfort, take preventive measures including workload and workstation design, training, protective equipment and clothing, routine medical surveillance, drinking water and electrolyte. Where risk arises from metabolic heat or direct exposure to sunlight and high outdoor temperatures, and other methods of eliminating risk are impracticable, provide a work-rest cycle, preferably in a shaded, cooler resting space.
violation_criteria: A photograph cannot establish temperature, workload, duration, symptoms, or whether other controls were impracticable. Obtain measurements and work-rest records before a legal finding.
corrective_action: Measure relevant conditions, review workload and work-rest records, and provide the rule-specified recovery and hydration measures where applicable.
issuing_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

hazard_description: construction site workplace passageway lighting illumination portable lighting emergency lighting glare shadows lamp guards electrical cables
indian_regulation: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (Central) Rules, 2026
applicability_conditions: Confirm Code coverage and that the Central Government is the appropriate government for the establishment. Rule 46 covers construction work; confirm the workplace, task, operating time, and whether lighting failure creates a risk.
required_safety_condition: Provide adequate task-suitable natural or artificial lighting where workers work or pass. Construction provisions address suitable portable lighting, glare and shadows, guards against lamp breakage where needed, and portable-lighting cables with adequate electrical and mechanical characteristics. Provide independent emergency lighting where failure of artificial lighting exposes workers to risk.
violation_criteria: A photograph can show dark areas or visible damage but cannot establish task-specific illuminance, power requirements, cable ratings, or emergency backup performance. Treat visual cues as a prompt for measurement and document review; do not make a conclusive finding from imagery alone.
corrective_action: Measure and verify lighting at active work and access routes; provide suitable portable and independent emergency lighting where required; guard lamps and inspect portable-lighting cables for electrical and mechanical suitability.
issuing_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India

hazard_description: quarterly emergency preparedness mock drills evacuation response fire emergency scenario records
indian_regulation: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions (Central) Rules, 2026
applicability_conditions: Confirm Code coverage and that the Central Government is the appropriate government for the establishment. Rule 59 applies to building or other construction work and requires review of the applicable emergency scenarios and records.
required_safety_condition: The employer must conduct mock drills quarterly to check preparedness for various emergencies.
violation_criteria: Drill frequency, worker participation, scenario coverage, and corrective follow-up cannot be established from a site image. Verify the drill schedule, dated records, attendance, and follow-up actions. Without those records, classify the result as Insufficient Evidence.
corrective_action: Schedule and conduct a quarterly emergency drill, document participation and scenario coverage, and track corrective actions to closure.
issuing_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
